definitions.explanation: A hard, coarse-grained igneous rock, often grey or pink, used for buildings, monuments and gravestones.

examples.japanese: {花崗岩|かこうがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{墓石|ぼせき}→墓石：27326_boseki⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{花崗岩|かこうがん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This mountain is made of granite.

examples.japanese: {花崗岩|かこうがん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{硬|かた}くて→硬い：01116_katai⟧⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外壁|がいへき}→外壁：06426_gaiheki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Granite is hard and durable, so it is often used for the outer walls of buildings.

notes:
In Japan, granite quarried around Kobe was once sold as ⟦{御影石|みかげいし}→御影石：29109_mikageishi⟧, and that name is still the usual word for granite as a building and gravestone stone; {花崗岩|かこうがん} is the geological term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花崗岩|かこうがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{墓石|ぼせき}→墓石：27326_boseki⟧: a granite gravestone
- {花崗岩|かこうがん}{質|しつ}: granitic

- ⟦{御影石|みかげいし}→御影石：29109_mikageishi⟧: granite as a stone for building and gravestones
